findings.description: The new Ceilings say pup kills every stage's process group, so only a process that calls `setsid` escapes. That is true for runGateChild only. runGateChildSync (src/core/sandbox.utils.ts L353-368, used for the custom adapter's depGraph under `pup map`) is never group-killed, so a process backgrounded there with `&` escapes without `setsid`. Scope the sentence to async stages, or name the sync child as an exception.

Decision 117 has already landed, but this PR rewrites it in place, Ceilings and the sixth-test description included, and adds a "This record first said…" history note (left unreflowed at L116). docs/adr/README.md §Reading and writing says a landed decision gets a dated amendment section citing the PR, or a new decision with `Amends: 117`.

Both tests spell out the full rationale for renaming within the checkout instead of using mv's cross-volume copy-then-delete, and the ADR repeats it a third time. The second test could point to the first. `// A sanity check: the refused rename is the proof.` appears twice: it contradicts itself and explains no WHY (general.md §Comments).
In the Ceilings paragraph, "is out of its reach too" (L113-114) repeats "is out of reach" from L110. Fold the `.worktrees` sentence into the one before it, or reword it.
